title: 第07章 人皇讲道百年后巡视生命禁区第08章 混沌至宝新成员入群人欲道祖师爷
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
原著中。
北斗的太古皇族挺多的。
万龙巢、火麟洞、黄金族地、血凰山、原始湖、斗战圣猿、神蚕一族……
但现在。
太古万族明面上的皇族并不多。
因为剩下的那几个古皇暂时还没有出世，血凰古皇、元皇、斗战圣皇、神蚕古皇……
如今距离太古末年还有一段时间。
人皇山之巅。
林昭平静的盘坐在此地，他的身形伟岸挺拔，浓密的黑发披肩，俊朗的面庞看不见丝毫情绪，一双深邃的眼眸宛若能够洞穿人心。
他任凭万灵朝拜自己。
最后轻轻挥手。
托起众人。
随即。
林昭也没有多说什么废话。
他直接开门见山道：“本皇今日便在此讲道三年，能够领悟多少全靠尔等自身的悟性。”
说完。
林昭便轻声讲述起了自身对于大道的理解，其中包含了他对各大秘境的修炼感悟。
这是每一位成道者的传统。
万族前来朝拜。
皇者讲道。

当然。
这里的万族指的并不是太古万族，而是整个宇宙的万族众生，太古万族只是万族众生的一部分。
二者不能混为一谈。
“轰隆！”
林昭盘坐在人皇山之巅。
他口中吐出大道真言，无穷的天地异象降临，万千法则演化出秩序神链，天地万道与天心共鸣，天花乱坠，地涌金莲……
见此一幕。
万族众生连忙安静盘坐。
他们全神贯注的听着人皇讲述的大道真言，如痴如醉。
很快。
三年时间眨眼而过。
时间一到。
林昭便停止了讲道。
万族众生有些遗憾的睁开双眸。
他们眼巴巴的看向了人皇，想要恳求人皇多讲几年，但林昭没有给他们开口的机会，便挥手道：“时间已到，尔等自行离去吧……”
人皇开口。
万族众生莫敢不从。
他们就算再怎么遗憾，也只能无奈的离去。
“吾等拜谢人皇讲道之恩。”
万族众生恭恭敬敬的行了一礼。

最后这才离去。
林昭看着他们离去的身影。
他不动声色的传音让一批人留了下来，就是前面在古皇山外与太古族打嘴炮的那一批人族。
他这古皇山太空旷了。
他准备让这些人帮忙打理一二。
content_en:
In the original work.
There are quite a lot of ancient royal families in Beidou.
Ten Thousand Dragons' Nest, Huolin Cave, Golden Clan Land, Blood Phoenix Mountain, Primitive Lake, Fighting Holy Ape, Divine Silkworm Clan...
But now.
There are not many royal families in the Taikoo Ten Thousand Clan.
Because the remaining ancient emperors have not been born yet, the Blood Phoenix Ancient Emperor, the Yuan Emperor, the Dou Zhan Saint Emperor, the Divine Silkworm Ancient Emperor...
It is still some time before the end of the ancient times.
The top of Renhuang Mountain.
Lin Zhao sat here calmly, with a tall and tall figure, thick black hair shawl, a handsome face without any emotion, and a pair of deep eyes that seemed to be able to penetrate people's hearts.
He allowed all spirits to worship him.
Finally wave gently.
Lift everyone up.
immediately.
Lin Zhao didn't say any nonsense.
He went straight to the point: "I will be preaching here for three years today. How much you can understand depends entirely on your own understanding."
Finished.
Lin Zhao then softly talked about his understanding of the Great Dao, which included his cultivation insights into the major secret realms.
This is the tradition of every enlightened person.
All races come to worship.
The emperor preached.
certainly.
The ten thousand races here do not refer to the ancient ten thousand races, but all the sentient beings of all races in the entire universe. The primeval ten thousand races are only a part of all races and sentient beings.
The two cannot be confused.
"Boom!"
Lin Zhao was sitting cross-legged on the top of Renhuang Mountain.
The mantra of the Great Way came out of his mouth, endless visions of heaven and earth descended, thousands of laws evolved into the divine chain of order, the myriad ways of heaven and earth resonated with the heart of heaven, flowers fell from the sky, and golden lotuses surged from the earth...
See this scene.
All the sentient beings of all races quickly sat down quietly.
They listened with rapt attention to the great truth narrated by the Emperor, and were mesmerized.
soon.
Three years flew by in the blink of an eye.
When the time comes.
Lin Zhao stopped preaching.
All sentient beings opened their eyes with regret.
They looked at the Human Emperor eagerly, wanting to beg the Human Emperor to talk for a few more years, but Lin Zhao did not give them a chance to speak, so he waved his hand and said: "The time has come, you can leave on your own..."
The Human Emperor spoke.
No sentient being of any race dares to disobey.
No matter how sorry they were, they could only leave helplessly.
"We thank the Emperor for his sermon."
All living beings of all races bowed respectfully.
Finally he left.
Lin Zhao watched them leave.
His calm message allowed a group of people to stay, the same group of humans who had been quarreling with the Taikoo tribe outside the Ancient Emperor Mountain.
His Guhuang Mountain is too empty.
He was going to let these people help take care of things.
